summary: Linear and circular progress indicators, determinate or indeterminate, with a formatted value.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value; without value it is indeterminate.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name without a visible label (localized default “Avanzamento”).

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the value (default: yes when determinate; circular: not in sm).

accessibility: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/valuetext; indeterminate without valuenow.
Tone is not the only indicator: the value remains as text.
Reduced animations with prefers-reduced-motion; system colors in forced-colors mode.
responsive: Full-width bar; the circle has fixed token-based dimensions.
customization: className/style; colors from the action and feedback roles.
commonMistakes: Updating the value many times per second: throttle updates for screen readers.

examples.name: Controlled
examples.title: Controlled value
examples.description: −10/+10 buttons update the linear and circular bars; the tone changes at the 70% and 90% thresholds.

examples.name: SizesAndFormats
examples.title: Sizes, formats and indeterminate
examples.description: Three sizes with a toggle for the indeterminate state, custom range, hidden label and long label.
